english:
A Tier 2 Super that grants <pve 90% /> <pvp [58%] /> Damage Resistance and lasts 24.5 seconds without attacking, draining 4.1% Super Energy per second.

Light Attacks consume 5% Super Energy to deal up to <pve 964 /> <pvp [200] /> damage and make enemies <void Volatile /> in a 6 meter radius. Damage falls off to 50% of normal damage at maximum Damage Falloff.

Holding [Fire] charges the attack over 0.6 seconds, pulling enemies within ~14 meters toward you. Charging linearly increases the attack's damage and radius by up to 120% and decreases Movement Speed by ?%.

Heavy Attack or Sprint activates Dark Blink, consuming 3.5% Super Energy to rapidly accelerate in your movement input direction. It also releases 4 seekers, one in each cardinal direction. These target enemies within 8 meters and deal <pve 193 /> <pvp [?] /> damage, <void Weakening /> them on impact.

source.text:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [58%]
Base Duration: 24.5 seconds, or 4.1% Super Drain per second.

Light Attack
Drains 5% Super Energy.
Deals up to 964 [200] damage, and inflicting Volatile in a 6 metre radius. Maximum Damage Falloff reduces damage by up to 50%.
Can be charged by holding [Fire] for 0.6 seconds, pulling enemies within ~14 meters towards the user and linearly increasing its damage and radius by 120%.
Decreases Movement Speed by ?% while charging.

Heavy Attack / Sprint
Performs a Dark Blink, draining 3.5% Super Energy to rapidly accelerate towards the currently input direction and release 4 Weakening Seekers, one in each cardinal direction.
Weakening Seekers target enemies within 8 meters, dealing 193 [?] Damage and inflicting Weaken on impact.
Tier 2 Super

Base Cooldown:
556 seconds
